capabilities: jump the cursor to the beginning or end of words and lines via on-screen tags
jump to any character occurrence by typing the target character and a tag label
bind each navigation mode separately or cycle through them with one toggle-and-jump command
customize the indexing and tagging behavior
problem: Moving the cursor to a distant word or line in the editor requires repeated arrow keys or mouse use, which is slow for keyboard-driven users.

relations.evidence: This plugin is inspired by Emacs-Avy

summary: Cursor navigation plugin that overlays labeled tags on matching text so you can jump to words, lines, or characters in a few keystrokes.
